tex_content.label: eq:tail-equivalence
tex_content.html: \begin{equation} \operatorname {Tail}(T')\amalg D_T \; \cong \; \operatorname {Tail}(T) \end{equation} is bijective because every ledger event at least $T$ is either $T$ itself or is at least $T'$ by successor minimality. The two cases are disjoint, and every index in the right-hand side belongs to one of them. The equivalence preserves the carrier pointwise, so reindexing does not alter any region or gluing map.
